# Phase 2: Core - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-10-20
**Status:** Ready for planning
**Mode:** Auto-generated (discuss skipped via workflow.skip_discuss); decisions below are LOCKED — from the user-approved ultrathink specification (nodes n4 SPE-17753, n6 SPE-17754, n5 SPE-17750) refined by `.planning/research/` (ARCHITECTURE.md §ACP/omp RPC, PITFALLS.md 1–5, FEATURES.md live `omp acp` probe) and Phase 1's shipped contracts.

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

Any prompt string becomes exactly one IntentEnvelope, runs through a typed ACP/RPC harness with an explicit state machine and a scripted in-memory adapter, lands in an append-only sequence-numbered session log, and streams out of a secured, observable API as resumable Server-Sent Events. Deliverables: `OmpOS.Parser`, `OmpOS.Harness.Abstractions`, `OmpOS.Harness.InMemory`, `OmpOS.Harness.Acp` (real ACP v1 client), `OmpOS.Harness.Rpc` (real omp RPC client), `OmpOS.Sessions`, `OmpOS.GenUi` (protocol→StreamEvent→UiBlock reducer), `OmpOS.Api` converted to an ASP.NET Core 10 host with SSE, config, health, OpenTelemetry, auth boundary, rate limiting, OpenAPI; test projects per library plus `OmpOS.Harness.ContractTests` and `OmpOS.Api.IntegrationTests`; `deploy/Dockerfile` for the API (built with podman). No sandbox/workflow bodies (Phase 3), no UI components (Phase 4).

</domain>

<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### D-01 Prompt parser contract (PARSE-01..04) — LOCKED
- `IPromptRecognizer { int Order; RecognizerResult TryRecognize(PromptContext ctx); }` registered via DI (`services.AddPromptParser().AddRecognizer<T>()`); `PromptPipeline.Parse(string raw) : IntentEnvelope` is pure, never throws (every recognizer call wrapped; exceptions become `Diagnostic` entries with `Severity.Error` and recognizer name), and always ends in `FallbackRecognizer`, which is constructed inside the pipeline (not registered, not removable, not reorderable); a test proves registering a recognizer with `Order = int.MaxValue` still runs before the fallback and that removing all recognizers still yields a `PlainPrompt` envelope.
- Recognizer order: `SlashCommandRecognizer` (`/name args…` at message start, name `[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*`), `MentionRecognizer` (`@path/or/name` tokens and `#line` suffixes → `Resources`), `DirectiveRecognizer` (structured `key: value` directives in a leading fenced `ompos` block or `--flag=value` tokens at the end), `MagicKeywordRecognizer` (omp rules: exact lowercase `ultrathink|orchestrate|workflowz|jevify` as standalone prose; punctuation/quotes may touch; letters, digits, `_`, `/`, `\`, `-`, file extensions, `::`, `()` do not match; fenced code (``` or ~~~), inline code spans, HTML comments/tags/elements and their contents are ignored), `PlainPromptRecognizer` is NOT a thing — plain text falls to `FallbackRecognizer`.
- `IntentEnvelope` (Contracts, Phase 1 shape) fields: `RawText` (byte-for-byte original, never trimmed), `NormalizedText` (newlines → `\n`, trailing whitespace trimmed, control chars except `\t\n` removed), `IntentKind` (`PlainPrompt`, `SlashCommand`, `Steer`, `FollowUp`, `Directive`), `Arguments` (ordered list + map), `Resources` (uri + kind), `MagicKeywords`, `Confidence` (0–1), `Diagnostics`, `Truncated` flag. `MaxPromptLength = 64_000` chars: longer input is NOT rejected — the envelope keeps the full `RawText`, `NormalizedText` is cut at the limit on a UTF-16 surrogate-safe boundary, and a `PromptTruncated` diagnostic is added. Empty/whitespace-only → `PlainPrompt` with `EmptyPrompt` diagnostic, `Confidence = 0`.
- Injection-style text ("SYSTEM:", "ignore previous instructions", `<system>` tags) is data: no recognizer may elevate it; a test asserts the envelope kind stays `PlainPrompt` and the text is preserved.

### D-02 Harness abstractions and state machine (HARN-01, HARN-02) — LOCKED
- `OmpOS.Harness.Abstractions`: `IAcpTransport { ConnectAsync(ct); SendAsync(OutboundFrame, ct); IAsyncEnumerable<InboundFrame> ReceiveAsync(ct); CloseAsync(ct); }`, `IOmpSession { CreateAsync(SessionLaunchOptions, ct); ResumeAsync(sessionId, ct); NegotiateAsync(ct) → HarnessCapabilities; IAsyncEnumerable<HarnessEvent> SubmitPromptAsync(IntentEnvelope, ct); CancelAsync(ct); DisposeAsync(); HarnessState State; }`, `IEngineHost`/`IHarnessFactory` for heads to obtain sessions, `IToolApprovalPolicy { ApprovalDecision Evaluate(PermissionRequest) }` with decisions `Deny`, `AskUser`, `AllowOption(optionId)` — the policy may only deny earlier or defer to the user; it must never grant an option the agent did not offer (test). Default registration = `DenyByPolicy` (denies execute/delete/move kinds, defers read/edit to the user).
- `HarnessEvent` union (records): `TextDelta`, `ThoughtDelta`, `ToolCallStarted`, `ToolCallUpdated`, `PermissionRequested`, `PlanUpdated` (replace-all), `UiBlockEmitted`, `ConfigOptionsUpdated`, `AvailableCommandsUpdated`, `ErrorRaised` (with `Retryable`), `Completed` (with `StopReason`: `EndTurn|MaxTokens|MaxTurnRequests|Refusal|Cancelled|Error`). Exactly one `Completed` per prompt (`CompleteOnce` guard; a second is a `DuplicateCompletionException` surfaced as `ErrorRaised` + Faulted).
- `HarnessState { Disconnected, Connecting, Handshaking, Ready, Streaming, Cancelling, Faulted, Disposed }` with a static `AllowedTransitions` table: Disconnected→Connecting; Connecting→Handshaking|Faulted|Disconnected; Handshaking→Ready|Faulted; Ready→Streaming|Disposed|Disconnected; Streaming→Ready|Cancelling|Faulted|Disconnected; Cancelling→Ready|Faulted|Disconnected; Faulted→Disposed|Disconnected; Disposed is terminal. `HarnessStateMachine.Transition(to)` throws `InvalidHarnessTransitionException` otherwise; every allowed and a sample of disallowed transitions are tested.
- Exceptions: `HarnessException` base → `ProcessStartException`, `HandshakeTimeoutException`, `MalformedFrameException`, `TransportDisconnectedException`, `BackpressureException` (bounded channel full with `BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait` default and a documented `DropOldest` option), `DuplicateCompletionException`, `ProtocolViolationException`.

### D-03 In-memory adapter and contract fixtures (HARN-03, HARN-06) — LOCKED
- `OmpOS.Harness.InMemory`: `ScriptedOmpSession` driven by a `HarnessScript` (ordered steps with optional delays and fault injections: `FailStart`, `HangHandshake`, `EmitMalformed`, `DisconnectMidStream`, `EmitDuplicateCompletion`, `SlowConsumerProbe`) and `InMemoryTransport` (channel pair). A `DefaultHelloScript` emits: TextDelta×N ("Hello from OmpOS…"), ToolCallStarted/Updated (kind `read`, status pending→completed), PlanUpdated, a `UiBlockEmitted` carrying an A2UI v0.9.1 `createSurface` + `updateComponents` payload (Text + Card + Button) and a markdown block, then `Completed(EndTurn)`.
- `tests/OmpOS.Harness.ContractTests`: abstract `OmpSessionContractTests<TFixture>` and `AcpTransportContractTests<TFixture>` (xunit.v3 abstract classes with a fixture factory) covering lifecycle, event ordering, cancellation, single completion, backpressure, and the six failure modes; concrete subclasses run them against the in-memory implementations; a `WebSocketTransportStub` (`OmpOS.Harness.Abstractions` or `.Acp`) returns typed `NotAvailable` from `ConnectAsync`, passes the transport fixture's "connect-fails-cleanly" subset, and carries owner tag `ompos-maintainers` + open-question id.

### D-04 Real ACP v1 client (HARN-04) — LOCKED
- `OmpOS.Harness.Acp`: `JsonRpcConnection` (newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over a `Stream` pair; outbound requests with incrementing integer ids; responses matched by id, never order; inbound notifications and agent→client requests dispatched to handlers; `$/cancel_request` sent when a pending request's token is cancelled; error code `-32800` mapped to cancellation), `StdioProcessTransport` (spawns `omp acp` via `ProcessStartInfo` with explicit approval flags from `SessionLaunchOptions` — never inherits `~/.omp` implicitly in tests; one reader task per stream from process start; stderr to a bounded ring buffer; shutdown = close stdin → drain stdout to EOF → wait exit → interpret exit code), `AcpOmpSession : IOmpSession` implementing `initialize` (protocolVersion 1, clientCapabilities `fs.readTextFile/writeTextFile` per `SessionLaunchOptions`, `terminal: false` always in this phase), `authenticate` passthrough, `session/new {cwd, mcpServers: []}` (reads `configOptions`, `modes`, `agentCapabilities` at runtime — never assumes `delete`), `session/load`, `session/prompt` (ContentBlock[] from the IntentEnvelope: text + embedded resources), `session/cancel` (mark pending tool calls cancelled, answer all pending `session/request_permission` with `cancelled`, keep accepting updates until the prompt response with `stopReason: cancelled`), `session/update` → HarnessEvent mapping for the 14 sessionUpdate kinds (unknown kinds → `UnknownUpdate` diagnostic event, never throw), `session/request_permission` → `IToolApprovalPolicy` then `PermissionRequested` event for `AskUser` with the agent's options verbatim, `fs/read_text_file`/`fs/write_text_file` served through an `IFileAccess` abstraction (denied by default on the API host), `session/close` when advertised. All DTOs in a `AcpJsonContext` (STJ source-gen).
- Smoke test (`[Fact]` skipped when `omp` is not on PATH): spawn `omp acp --approval-mode default --config <temp overlay>`, `initialize`, assert `agentCapabilities.loadSession`, `session/new` with a temp cwd, assert `configOptions` contains categories `mode`, `model`, `thinking`, then `session/close`/dispose; asserts process exit 0 and no stderr-captured fatal lines. No prompt turn (no model spend).

### D-05 Real omp RPC client (HARN-05) — LOCKED
- `OmpOS.Harness.Rpc`: `OmpRpcConnection` over `omp --mode rpc --no-ui`: parse the `ready` frame (`protocolVersion`, `supportedProtocolVersions`, `maxFrameBytes`, `maxReassembledFrameBytes`), send `negotiate_protocol` v2 immediately, reassemble `rpc_chunk` sequences (validate `chunkId`/`index`/`count`/`byteLength`, 64 MiB cap, `rpc_frame_error` → typed transport event), keep every inbound frame < 1 MiB, correlate `response` frames by `id`, implement two-phase prompt (`prompt` → `response` on admission → `prompt_result` exactly once → `session_settled`), `abort` and `abort_and_restore_queue`, `get_state`, `set_model`, `set_thinking_level`, `get_available_commands`, `steer`, `follow_up`, event demux for `message_update`, `tool_execution_start/update/end`, `tool_stream_update`, `agent_start/agent_end`, `queue_update`, `notice`, extension UI requests (answered with defaults in headless mode), host tools (`set_host_tools` empty in this phase). `RpcOmpSession : IOmpSession` maps frames to the same `HarnessEvent` union. DTOs in `OmpRpcJsonContext`.
- Smoke test (skipped when `omp` absent): spawn `omp --mode rpc --no-ui`, read `ready`, negotiate v2, send `get_state`, assert a `response` with `success: true` and `data.model`, then close stdin, drain, assert exit 0.

### D-06 Sessions, GenUi reducer, orchestration (SESS-01..03) — LOCKED
- `OmpOS.Sessions`: `SessionActor` (one `Channel`-driven loop per session; single writer of the session's event log), `SessionService` (create/get/list/submit/cancel/approve), `ISessionRepository { Get, Save, Append(StreamEvent), ListEvents(sessionId, fromSeq, ct), List(ownerId) }` + `InMemorySessionRepository` (concurrent dictionary + per-session lock; Seq assigned by the repository on append, gapless, starting at 1), `tests/OmpOS.Sessions.Tests` including abstract `SessionRepositoryContractTests<T>`.
- One active prompt per session: a second `SubmitPrompt` while `Running`/`AwaitingToolApproval` fails with `OmpOSError { Code = PromptInFlight }` (API: HTTP 409 problem+json) — never queued silently; `IntentKind.Steer`/`FollowUp` are routed to `IOmpSession` queue operations when the adapter supports them (`HarnessCapabilities.SupportsQueuedMessages`) and otherwise rejected with `OmpOSError { Code = NotSupported }`.
- `OmpOS.GenUi`: `EventReducer.Reduce(HarnessEvent) → StreamEvent payload` and `BlockProjector.Project(IEnumerable<StreamEvent>) → IReadOnlyList<UiBlock>` are pure; replaying the same event log twice yields structurally equal block lists (Verify.XunitV3 snapshot + equality test); unknown payloads → `UnknownBlock` with raw JSON retained.
- SessionStatus transitions: Idle→Running (submit), Running→AwaitingToolApproval (PermissionRequested) → Running (answered), Running→Completed|Failed|Cancelled (Completed stop reasons), Failed/Cancelled→Running on a new submit (new prompt turn), Completed→Running likewise; persisted on every transition.

### D-07 API host (API-01..03, OPS-01..04) — LOCKED
- `services/OmpOS.Api` becomes `Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web` (minimal APIs): `POST /sessions` (create; body `CreateSessionRequest { Cwd?, Title? }`), `GET /sessions` (list for the principal), `GET /sessions/{id}`, `POST /sessions/{id}/prompts` (body `SubmitPromptRequest { Text, Attachments? }`, max 256 KiB body via `RequestSizeLimit`, content-type `application/json` enforced, returns 202 with `promptId` or 409 `PromptInFlight`), `DELETE /sessions/{id}/prompts/current` (cancel), `POST /sessions/{id}/approvals/{toolCallId}` (`{ optionId }` or `{ cancelled: true }`, idempotent), `GET /sessions/{id}/events` SSE via `TypedResults.ServerSentEvents(IAsyncEnumerable<SseItem<StreamEvent>>)` with `EventId = Seq`, resume from `Last-Event-ID` header or `?since=` (replay from the repository then live tail), heartbeat comment every 15 s, `Cache-Control: no-cache`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no`, response compression disabled for the route, HTTP 204 when the session is terminal and the client is already at the last Seq, typed `ResumeGapError` (410) when `since` is beyond retention; `GET /health/live`, `GET /health/ready` (readiness checks: harness factory can create an in-memory session, repository responds, Temporal client connects when `Workflows:Enabled` — the Temporal check is registered in Phase 3; Phase 2 registers harness + repository), `GET /openapi/v1.json` (Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi, 3.1) with the document also generated at build time into `services/OmpOS.Api/openapi/v1.json` via `Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server` and committed; `Scalar.AspNetCore` UI in Development only.
- Cross-cutting: `OmpOsOptions` (`Engine:Adapter` = `InMemory|Acp|Rpc` default `InMemory`; `Engine:OmpPath`; `Streaming:HeartbeatSeconds`; `Streaming:RetentionEvents`; `Cors:AllowedOrigins[]` REQUIRED non-empty outside Development; `RateLimit:PromptsPerMinute`; `Workflows:Enabled` default false; `Telemetry:OtlpEndpoint?`) as `[OptionsValidator]` source-generated validators with `ValidateOnStart`; startup failure message names the missing key and the env var form (`OMPOS__Cors__AllowedOrigins__0`); `.env.example` at repo root documents every variable with a comment. Configuration layering: `appsettings.json` → `appsettings.{Environment}.json` → environment (`OMPOS__` prefix) → `appsettings.local.json` (gitignored) — in that order.
- Correlation: `X-Correlation-ID` accepted or generated (ULID/GUID), echoed in responses, stored on `StreamEvent.CorrelationId`, flowed through `ILogger` scopes and `Activity` baggage into harness and (Phase 3) sandbox calls; structured logging via `Microsoft.Extensions.Logging` JSON console formatter; `PromptRedactor` replaces prompt text and anything matching `SecretRef`/bearer/API-key patterns in log state with `[REDACTED]` unless `Logging:IncludePromptText=true` (Development default false); a canary-secret test proves the canary never appears in logs or SSE output.
- OpenTelemetry: `AddOpenTelemetry().WithTracing(...).WithMetrics(...)` with `ActivitySource "OmpOS"` spans for parse → submit → harness turn → SSE write, meters `ompos.sessions.active`, `ompos.stream.latency_ms`, `ompos.parser.fallback_rate`, `ompos.sandbox.provision_ms` (registered now, emitted in Phase 3), OTLP exporter when `Telemetry:OtlpEndpoint` is set, console exporter in Development.
- Auth boundary: `IUserContext { string PrincipalId; }` resolved by `AuthBoundaryMiddleware` from a `DevPrincipalProvider` (fixed id `dev-local`) with a documented extension point (`IPrincipalResolver`); every session stores `OwnerId` and list/get filter by it. Rate limiting via the in-box `AddRateLimiter` fixed-window policy per session+principal for `POST …/prompts`, pluggable through `IPromptRateLimitPolicy` (in-memory default).
- CORS: `AllowedOrigins` only; no wildcard outside Development; `Vary: Origin`.
- `deploy/Dockerfile` (OCI, multi-stage `mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0` → `mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0-noble-chiseled`, non-root, `HEALTHCHECK` via `/health/live`), `deploy/railway.toml` (config-as-code: builder dockerfile path, healthcheck path, restart policy) — no deployment performed. CI gains `podman build -f deploy/Dockerfile .` only if podman is available on the runner (guarded step).
- `tests/OmpOS.Api.IntegrationTests` (WebApplicationFactory + in-memory adapter): prompt → SSE stream yields TextDelta…Completed with increasing Seq; disconnect after N events then reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` yields exactly the remaining events (no gap, no duplicate); concurrent second prompt → 409; approval round-trip; health endpoints; CORS preflight rejection for an unlisted origin; missing config → startup exception message names the key; correlation id echoed and present in captured log scopes.

### Claude's Discretion
Internal naming of records/handlers, folder layout within projects, test data builders, exact ULID vs GUID for ids, Scalar vs none for the dev UI, whether `Harness.InMemory` lives in its own project or inside `Harness.Abstractions` (prefer own project as Phase 1 scaffolded it).

<specifics>
## Specific Ideas

- Keep the two harness assemblies free of each other; both reference only `Harness.Abstractions` + `Contracts`. `OmpOS.Web` must never reference them (architecture test already asserts).
- ACP and RPC DTOs are internal to their assemblies; only `HarnessEvent`/`HarnessCapabilities` cross the boundary.
- Record real `session/update` frames captured during the smoke tests (no prompt turn) as JSON fixtures under `tests/OmpOS.Harness.Acp.Tests/Fixtures/` for mapper tests; fixtures from `omp://rpc.md` examples for RPC.
- `ADR-0003-streaming-sse.md`, `ADR-0004-engine-integration-acp-and-rpc.md`, `ADR-0005-prompt-parser-catch-all.md` are written in this phase (docs/decisions), and `docs/architecture.md` gains the event-flow sequence diagram.

</specifics>
